entries.reason: Quadratic CPU consumption in !!omap resolution (CVE-2026-59870, CWE-407). The fix was not backported to the 4.x line, so no patched 4.x exists; only js-yaml 5.x carries it, and every path here is transitive through eslint, firebase-tools and shadcn, where a major bump risks breaking lint and the Firebase CLI that deploys the functions.
entries.mitigation: All three parents (eslint, firebase-tools, shadcn) are devDependencies and are absent from the Next build output, so no deployed code path parses YAML with this library. The tooling only reads YAML the operator controls — apphosting.yaml, firebase config — never attacker-supplied input. Revisit when eslint and firebase-tools move to js-yaml 5.x.
